verdict.rationale: Bolt's own docs say Code view lets you see the raw code behind a project and edit it directly inside the builder, and these direct edits are free because they use no tokens. A community user also mentions inspecting the generated code, though not editing it by hand. missing for 10: detailed documentation of editor capabilities (file tree, search, multi-file editing), independent hands-on corroboration of manual edits in Code view.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open and edit the generated source code directly inside the builder
